title: Successive counter overhead
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and natural number $r$, the counter overhead through round $r+1$ equals the overhead through round $r$ plus $2\ell_r+2$, where $\ell_r$ is the number of consecutive false bits at the beginning of the counter word after $r$ decrement steps.
